_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::pasi#4, and a falsification of its Signal. The rule holds — structure and particles need separate geometry blocks — but a particle line dropped into STRUCTURE ELEMENTS of upstream pasi_twoway_norelax_particle_dem_1d_normalcontact_linspring_walldiscretcond.4C.yaml is read as an element line, so the parser trips on the first token while trying to read an element id: "Could not parse 'TYPE' as an integer value." from core/io/src/4C_io_value_parser.cpp line 90. Nothing in that mentions particles, the PARTICLES section or a structural mesh; it reads as an ordinary malformed-element error, which sends the reader to the wrong place. There is no 'unexpected particle entry in structural mesh' string in 4C. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Could not parse 'TYPE' as an integer value.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave STRUCTURE ELEMENTS alone. No particle line is injected, the parse error vanishes, PARTICLE_LINE_INJECTED becomes 0 and EXIT_MIXED becomes 0, so the fixture must go red.
